name: 1Password
summary:
1Password is the password manager at 1password.com. The blue keyhole mark in the tab is the icon vault bookmarks use, saved from that host.

Checked 12 November 2026 against 1password.com. HTML came from https://1password.com/ (HTTP 200). Icon link tags: icon → https://1password.com/favicon.ico; icon → https://1password.com/favicon/icon-v2.svg; icon → https://1password.com/favicon-light.ico; icon → https://1password.com/favicon/icon-v2-light.svg; apple-touch-icon → https://1password.com/apple-touch-icon.png; mask-icon → https://1password.com/pinned-tab-v2.svg.

The favicon.ico URL is https://1password.com/favicon.ico. The saved file favicon.ico is 15406 bytes. Directory sizes: 16×16, 32×32, 48×48.

An apple-touch-icon URL was declared (https://1password.com/apple-touch-icon.png), but that response was not saved as an image, so there is no apple-touch download on this page.

No brand colour could be derived. The page had no theme-color, mask-icon colour, or manifest theme_color, and a dominant pixel colour was not readable from the saved PNGs.

Largest measured bitmap: svg-32x32-02.svg at 32×32 (svg, 1156 bytes) from https://1password.com/favicon/icon-v2.svg.
